    The descended tracial state on the tracial-ultraproduct quotient (Brick 4g) #

    Bundles the committed linear trace quotientTrace into a full TracialState (MatrixSeqQuotient dim ω σ): the quotient's spectral order (now available from its CStarAlgebra instance), positivity of the trace (from the committed ultraTrace positivity via the StarOrderedRing.nonneg_iff closure), and traciality (from ultraTrace_tracial). This is the trace field needed to concretize TracialMatrixUltrapower.
